# Recording script: লেগুনা মামা — Formula F1

<!-- Generated by tools/recording_script.py from public/memes.json. Do not edit by hand: run `python3 tools/recording_script.py` again instead. -->

Almost every sound in the game is a computer-made placeholder. This is the list of everything we would love real voices and sounds for: the helper shouting warnings, passengers complaining, horns and bells. Pick any line, record it on your phone, and send it over.

## Checklist

| What | Total | Recorded | Left |
|---|---|---|---|
| Helper callouts (record these first) | 9 | 0 | 9 |
| Event voice clips | 6 | 6 | 0 |
| Meme voice lines | 91 | 0 | 91 |
| Sound effects | 25 | 0 | 25 |
| Clips already in the game | 7 | 7 | 0 |

## How to record

- **Quiet room**, fan off, door closed. Soft furnishings (a bedroom, a wardrobe full of clothes) beat a tiled bathroom.
- **Phone close**: about a hand's width (10–15 cm) from your mouth, slightly to the side so you don't pop the mic.
- **Re-perform** the line in your own voice. Don't rip clips from films, TikTok or YouTube.
- **2–3 takes** of each line with a little variation; we pick the best one (or use several, the game picks at random).
- **Short and punchy**: 1–3 seconds. Act it big: it plays over traffic noise, so energy matters more than polish.
- **Trim the silence** at the start and end, so the sound starts right on the word.
- Lines with English in them ("What happening?!") are said as written, in the meme accent.
- Emojis are just there to show the mood. Don't say them.

**Format:** mono MP3, 48–64 kbps, ideally under 40 KB per file. If that's fiddly, just send the raw phone recording (any format) with the file name below and we'll convert it.

**Where files go:** voice lines and callouts in `public/audio/voice/`, sound effects in `public/audio/sfx/`, using the suggested file name from the tables. Then hook the file up in `public/memes.json` by adding an `audio` list (the path is relative to `public/`):

```json
{ "bn": "মামা, আস্তে!", "en": "Mama, slow down!", "audio": ["audio/voice/closeturn-slow-down.mp3"] }
```

For a meme line add it to that line in `triggers`; for a helper callout or a sound effect add it to the event in `events` (several takes: list them all, one is picked at random). Then run `python3 tools/recording_script.py` to tick it off in this document.

## Helper callouts (top priority)

The helper hangs off the back of the leguna and shouts these every time something is coming up. They repeat constantly during a run, so they matter most. Shout them like a real helper: loud, quick, a bit hoarse, over the engine and the horns. Add the file to the event's `audio`.

| Event | When it plays | Bangla | Meaning | Delivery | Status | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `helper_left` | The helper hanging off the back warns about traffic on your left. | বামে প্লাস্টিক! | Plastic on the left! | Shouted warning over traffic noise, flat and practised, like he says it a hundred times a day. | To record | `voice/callout-left.mp3` |
| `helper_right` | The helper hanging off the back warns about traffic on your right. | ডানে প্লাস্টিক! | Plastic on the right! | Shouted warning over traffic noise, flat and practised, like he says it a hundred times a day. | To record | `voice/callout-right.mp3` |

## Voice lines

Meme popups that appear during the run, roughly in the order you meet them: start, driving, crashes, set pieces along the route, finish. Each event shows one of its lines at random, so any of them is useful. Add the file to that line's `audio`.

## Sound effects to record or source

Real-world sounds to replace the synthesised placeholders. Record them on the street (stand back from horns, they clip easily), or use a free clip that is **CC0 only** (public domain, no attribution needed), for example [Freesound](https://freesound.org) with the licence filter set to "Creative Commons 0". Note the source link when you send it. Add the file to the `audio` of each event listed.

| Placeholder | Real sound | Used by | Status | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `airhorn` | BRTC double-decker diesel air horn: deep, very loud, two blasts. | `brtc_honk`, `close_brtc`, `spawn_brtc` | To record | `sfx/airhorn.mp3` |
| `angryhonk` | Angry private-car horn: one long blast then three short ones. | `bump_honk` | To record | `sfx/angryhonk.mp3` |
| `beep` | Two short car horn beeps. | `close_car` | To record | `sfx/beep.mp3` |
| `bell` | Rickshaw bell: the quick "kring-kring" thumb bell. | `spawn_pedestrian`, `spawn_rickshaw` | To record | `sfx/bell.mp3` |
| `bigcrash` | Leguna into a double-decker: long, deep crash with a sheet-metal clang. | `crash_brtc`, `crash_vip` | To record | `sfx/bigcrash.mp3` |
| `boing` | Comedy "boing" (spring or a mouth sound). | `crash` meme line, `crash_pedestrian` | To record | `sfx/boing.mp3` |
| `bonus` | Short bright "bonus" chime, e.g. coins shaken in a hand. Can stay synthetic. | `close`, `close_bike`, `close_brtc`, `close_car`, `close_tesla`, `close_vip`, `closeturn`, `closeturn_bike`, `closeturn_brtc`, `closeturn_tesla`, `closeturn_vip` | To record | `sfx/bonus.mp3` |
| `clunk` | Wheel dropping into a pothole: heavy metal clunk and rattle. | `crash_manhole`, `pothole` | To record | `sfx/clunk.mp3` |
| `coin` | Coins dropped into the helper's hand or a tin box. | `pickup`, `stopped_at_red`, `vip_gaveway` | To record | `sfx/coin.mp3` |
| `crash` | Metal-and-plastic crash, not too long. | `crash`, `crash_bike`, `crash_cow`, `crash_manhole`, `crash_rickshaw`, `crash_tesla` | To record | `sfx/crash.mp3` |
| `crunch` | Bumper crunch: plastic cracking, a light car-to-car bump. | `crash_car` | To record | `sfx/crunch.mp3` |
